adaptation_notes: Android adaptive-icon layers preserve the canonical Browser compass/navigation identity and blue identity palette.
Foreground geometry is optically scaled into the Android adaptive-icon canvas rather than treated as a separate product identity.
Android 13+ monochrome artwork preserves the same compass ring and needle silhouette for themed icons.
The canonical SVG remains the source of truth; these XML files are platform-specific packaged derivatives only.
acceptance_boundary: Source provenance and package-resource validation do not establish GoreeCloud Launcher, Lineage/Trebuchet, representative-device, or production visual acceptance.
